name: get_code_snippet
description: Read source code for a function/class/symbol. IMPORTANT: First call search_graph to find the exact qualified_name, then pass it here. This is a read tool, not a search tool. Accepts full qualified_name (exact match) or short function name (returns suggestions if ambiguous). If the response carries a 'coverage_note', the file was only partially indexed — constructs in the noted line ranges may be missing from the graph (best-effort signal); prefer grep there and treat the returned source as ground truth.

qualified_name.description: Full qualified_name from search_graph, or short function name
